History of Solmaria, Volume 1 Since time began, we know for certain only that which was written; even then, we can not be sure. The following recounts the history of our world, Solmaria, since days were first numbered and recorded. The first account of humans that has been found begins with humans and Agmarians living together in peace on
《索尔玛利亚史》卷一 自时间肇始以来，我们唯一能确定的，只有被写下的东西；而即便是这些，也未必尽信。以下所述，是自日子开始被计数与记载以来，我们这个世界的史事。 目前发现的最早关于人类的记述，始于人类与阿格玛人和平共处于
res#60443/whatIHaveToSay[1]

the Isle of Springhold, and with a war. A mighty city, comprised of humans and Agmarians, fell into ruin from this war. The humans called themselves the Elok. There are different stories about why the Elok and Agmarians fought. Some say that the Agmarians stole something from the Elok, but most agree that the Agmarians betrayed the Elok in some way. Their city was torn apart, each race fleeing to different regions of Springhold.

	There were very likely humans in other regions of Solmaria at this time, but the world is vast and old, and we have

斯普林霍尔德岛，以及一场战争。一座由人类与阿格玛人共同建起的雄城毁于这场战争。人类自称为埃洛克。关于埃洛克与阿格玛人为何而战，说法不一：有人说是阿格玛人偷了埃洛克的东西，但多数人都同意，阿格玛人以某种方式背叛了埃洛克。他们的城市分崩离析，两族各自逃向斯普林霍尔德的不同区域。

	当时，索尔玛利亚的其他地区很可能也有人类生息，只是世界辽阔而古老，我们至今
res#60443/whatIHaveToSay[2]

yet to find record. The year of the war is recorded as year 0q; the q representing the Quadrivium, a word that refers to the knowledge accumulated about Solmaria and its moons, Tethrys, Gammon and Miala.

	It is from this point in history that we see writings, artwork and the use of q in dating begin to emerge. This pattern then spreads throughout the known world, suggesting that the Elok people scattered across the sea in the wake of the war, perhaps as refugees. Little mention of the Elok is made thereafter,

未能寻得记载。这场战争被记为 0q 年；q 代表「四元学」，这个词指的是关于索尔玛利亚及其三轮月亮（泰丝瑞斯、加蒙与米亚拉）所积累的全部知识。

	正是从历史的这一点开始，我们看到了文字、图画，以及用 q 纪年的做法相继出现。此后这一惯例传遍已知世界，暗示埃洛克人在战后渡海四散，或许是作为难民流亡。此后关于埃洛克的记载便寥寥无几，

as people groups began adopting new identities in their new lands. The Agmarians do not appear to have spread after this event, and are located solely on Springhold.

	The reluctance of Agmarians to move may suggest some sort of connection to this isle, perhaps an ancestral homeland or that they lost the war or did not have the resources to relocate. We do not know the outcome, except that the city fell and people scattered.

因为各族群开始在新土地上形成新的身份。而阿格玛人在此役之后似乎并未四散，仍只居于斯普林霍尔德。

	阿格玛人不愿迁徙，也许说明他们与这座岛有着某种联系，或许是祖地，又或许是他们战败、或没有力量迁走。结局如何，我们无从知晓，只知道城已倾覆，人已离散。

There is enmity to be found in nearly all scholarly works from this point on regarding the relationship between humans and Agmarians, and prejudices between the two appear to have held strongly despite lost connections between these two races. Little is known about Agmarians and whether they hold a distaste for humans. Few appear willing to approach them, and if some have, they may not have lived to tell the tale.
自此往后，几乎所有关于人类与阿格玛人关系的学术著作中都能读到敌意；尽管两族之间的纽带早已断失，彼此的偏见却似乎根深蒂固。关于阿格玛人、以及他们是否厌恶人类，所知甚少。愿意接近他们的人寥寥无几，就算有过，恐怕也没能活着讲述。
res#60443/whatIHaveToSay[5]

Writings from one unnamed author do mention an interaction with the Agmarians, and suggest that they may have attempted to rebuild a city on the Isle of Springhold, albeit hidden from sight. Only fragments remain of this work, however, and its authenticity is hard to verify.
有一位佚名作者的著述确实提到过与阿格玛人的往来，并暗示他们可能试图在斯普林霍尔德岛上重建一座城市，只是隐于视线之外。然而这部作品仅存残篇，真伪难辨。
